CHIEF COMPLAINT
Followup of chronic medical conditions

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Bruce is a 60-year-old male with past medical history significant for depression, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension presenting for followup of his chronic problems. Patient reports having had a stressful year and a half with significant anxiety, particularly related to holiday preparations. He recently attended Thanksgiving gatherings, which he found rewarding to see family after about two years but also very stressful and demanding. He is planning a vacation somewhere warm for the upcoming year.

Regarding depression: Patient is not currently on medication and prefers not to pursue pharmacotherapy at this time. Over the summer, he began daily morning walks which he found beneficial, particularly enjoying the weather and natural scenery. He also engaged in yard work on weekends for additional activity and sun exposure. However, with seasonal weather changes and colder temperatures, he has been unable to continue this routine and is interested in exploring alternative coping strategies. He denies any suicidal or homicidal ideation.

Regarding type 2 diabetes: Patient did not strictly adhere to diet restrictions during Halloween and Thanksgiving but reports improving compliance and actively monitoring intake. He continues to take metformin as prescribed.

Regarding hypertension: Patient purchased a blood pressure cuff as recommended. Blood pressure readings have been moderate and stable. He continues to tolerate lisinopril well without problems.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, blood in stool, or weight loss.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Depression
Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
Metformin
Lisinopril

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient is planning a vacation. Recently attended Thanksgiving gatherings with family. Previously engaged in morning walks and yard work.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital Signs: Blood pressure well-controlled.
Neck: No carotid bruits appreciated.
Cardiovascular: Slight 2/6 systolic ejection murmur heard at the left base, previously noted.
Pulmonary: Lungs clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ non-pitting edema bilaterally in lower extremities.

RESULTS
EKG: Performed in office. No concerning findings.
Hemoglobin A1C: 8 (elevated; goal closer to 6).

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Depression: Referral to psychiatry for talk therapy and counseling.
2. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Increase metformin to 1000 mg twice daily. Order hemoglobin A1C in next couple of months. Order lipid panel.
3. Hypertension: Order echocardiogram to recheck cardiac murmur. Continue lisinopril 20 mg daily.
